text:
Darin: FYI — Firefly sent back their acceptance criteria. They want a POC perf run tomorrow: mixed workload (chat gen + embeddings), target sustained 120 rps, 95th < 200ms, 99th < 400ms. Also asking for a ballpark monthly cost if they scale to ~50M tokens/month. Can we spin this up on a Dedicated pool?

Melissa: Copy. I'll coordinate ops. @Raman can you own the load plan + runbook? Also Firefly asked about KMS/HSM for encryption in the security questionnaire.

Raman: I can take. Quick notes: 1) Dedicated-small might be tight for sustained 120 rps depending on model size; recommend stepping the sweep 30 -> 60 -> 90 -> 120 and measure per-token latency and tail at each step. 2) We'll prewarm KV cache and run both chat and short-embed mixes. 3) I'll include a pricing ballpark.

Raman: Proposed commands (simplified) to reproduce the load:
```bash
# vegeta-style example targets file pointing at our generate endpoint
echo "POST https://redwood.example/v1/generate" > targets.txt
# step at 30/60/90/120 rps for 10m each
for rate in 30 60 90 120; do
  vegeta attack -targets=targets.txt -rate=${rate}/s -duration=10m | vegeta report -type=json > report_${rate}.json
done
```
(This also runs a warmup block of short prefixes to prime KV cache before the sweep.)

Eve: Add a warmup phase for prefix caching: send ~5k short prefix requests at low concurrency before the sweep. Also capture token counts and cost estimates per run. We'll watch 99th latency closely during the step-up.

deploy-bot: Cluster allocation scheduled: dedicated-small (2 x GPU slice) for 2026-03-25 09:00 UTC — request id req-9a7b.

Melissa: For the pricing ask: Firefly wants a ballpark monthly cost for 50M tokens. Quick calc I ran: hosted API ~ $0.0008/token -> ~$40k/month; dedicated reserved (2 GPU equiv) + infra + ops amortized -> ~ $18k-22k/month plus infra egress, but depends on utilization and quantization. Raman — can you firm this up with assumptions?

Raman: Yep. I'll produce a small table in the runbook with three scenarios: hosted, dedicated (2 GPU), dedicated (3 GPU) and assumptions: avg tokens per request, mean sequence length, expected utilization %. I'll also include quantized throughput numbers (fp16 vs int8).

Darin: Also add security Q answers: KMS/HSM supported for Private + Dedicated with customer-managed keys; include where audit logs are stored and retention options. Firefly flagged SOC2 and mustache-compliance items — CS will handle detailed docs but include summary.

Melissa: I'll prep a one-pager for the customer with the run schedule, pricing ballpark, and where to find the security attachments. Raman/Eve please drop results and raw reports into the runbook thread after the run.

Raman: Will do. Plan: warmup 15m, stepped sweep 40m total, post-run stabilizing queries 10m. I'll upload report_30.json,...,report_120.json and a short summary with graphs.

Eve: I'll watch infra and abort if 99th > 800ms or GPU memory/tpu pressure > 85%.

Melissa: Awesome. Ping me in the morning if anything flaps. :thumbsup:

Darin: Thanks team — customer demo Friday assuming green.
